notablePrerequisites: Leyline Immersion attached to a legendary creature you control without summoning sickness.
description:
Activate the creature with Leyline Immersion attached by tapping it, adding {4}{U} that can only be spent to cast spells.
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}, targeting Akroan Conscriptor.
Akroan Conscriptor triggers, causing you to untap the creature with Leyline Immersion attached.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use Akroan Conscriptor's ability to untap any other creature(s) you control.
